data.title: Fix Stripe Webhook Idempotency & Auth Leak
data.objective: Resolve duplicate event race conditions in webhook receiver and patch security vulnerabilities.
data.context: Production incident #4092: Duplicate credit issuance during network retry storm.

data.goal: Eliminate webhook race conditions and enforce strict signature security
acceptanceCriteria: Validate Stripe-Signature header using timing-safe compare
Store processed event IDs in Redis with 24h TTL to ensure idempotency
Handle concurrent duplicate requests gracefully with HTTP 200
Zero plaintext secrets or credentials in codebase
